source.request: One binary market per proposal in the Q3 2026 Zcash Coinholder-Directed Retroactive Grants poll (CDRGP). 37 proposals from the review-period list as published 2026-08-18.
source.proposalText: Will <title> be approved in the Q3 2026 Coinholder-Directed Retroactive Grants poll?
source.priceSourceNote: Created and first-seeded at a uniform yesPrice 0.55, which is what Seer's published pilot spec specifies. Re-priced 2026-08-24 to per-proposal forecasts (range 0.16-0.97, mean 0.62) from an externally supplied table. That reprice is a deliberate DEVIATION from the published spec: 0.55 is a uniform prior over a very non-uniform population (14 proposals under $25k are 1.7% of the dollars; 11 over $150k are 89.2%). The source table.tsv is not in this repo.

markets.marketNameTemplate: Will {title} be approved in the Q3 2026 Coinholder-Directed Retroactive Grants poll?

liquidity.unpooledByDesign: the Invalid result token from every split - one Q per market, 37 in total, never pooled

stages.name: phase1-create
stages.notes: 37/37 created and verified, 0 failures, 64,068,263 gas, 0.0000642 ETH. Reality question-id collision check clean on all 37.

stages.name: phase1-seed
stages.notes: 74/74 pools at the uniform 0.55. Exactly 20,000.000000 sUSDS; wallet 24,552.02 -> 4,552.02; 0.000409 ETH gas; 0 failures. Splits 5,159.61, sUSDS side 14,840.39.

stages.name: unwind-withdraw
stages.notes: 74/74 withdrawn, ahead of the reprice. Only 4 of 37 markets had traded.

stages.name: unwind-merge
stages.notes: 37/37 merged, 5,159.44 sUSDS recovered, 1.354 outcome tokens stranded. Round-trip cost 0.58 sUSDS plus gas.

stages.name: reseed
stages.notes: 74/74 re-seeded at per-proposal prices, 20,007.43 sUSDS (wallet 24,551.44 -> 4,544.01), ~0.00013 ETH over ~370 tx. 72/74 repriced; ZECMAP stayed at 0.55. Needed a 3-tx dust -> swap -> fund sequence per pool because a drained V3 pool keeps its price and createAndInitializePoolIfNecessary is a no-op on it.

evidenceLog.learning: A drained Uniswap V3 pool is not a gone pool - only a swap moves price, so re-pricing costs a swap per pool. Sizing the swap from DUST_Q is wrong: the shortfall is set by the range traversed, not by a constant, and SHIELDEDSCAN needed 0.036 against DUST_Q = 0.02. Size headroom from SqrtPriceMath over the traversed range and re-read the live balance before the fund step.
